metadata.description: Agent plugins that teach AI coding assistants how to build, migrate, and maintain Xperience by Kentico projects

plugins.name: kentico-digital-experience
plugins.description: Extend Xperience digital experience workflows with custom components, such as Automation actions that add custom step types to the Automation Builder

plugins.name: kentico-web-development
plugins.description: Build Xperience websites with AI assistance. Model content from designs, build Page Builder widgets and templates, write content retrieval code, and validate the result against the original design

plugins.name: kentico-kx13-migration
plugins.description: Migrate Kentico Xperience 13 projects to Xperience by Kentico by auditing the source content model, driving the Migration Tool, and porting live-site code

plugins.name: kentico-project-lifecycle
plugins.description: Manage Xperience by Kentico project lifecycle. Update Xperience projects to a target version and generate deployment-scoped CI/CD repository.config filters from selected pull requests or commits
